sourceRefs.locator: pp. 298–302, figs. 4a–c. Reconstructed successive fence lines in the south-eastern sector. Phase II encloses four graves, including graves 24 and 25 dated to the last third of the seventh century.

labels.en: Four graves inside a farmstead fence

note.de: Der zweite Zaun umschloss vier Gräber. Zwei Kammern sind ins letzte Drittel des siebten Jahrhunderts datiert. Anfang und Ende der Zaunnutzung bleiben offen.
note.en: The second fence enclosed four graves. Two chambers date to the last third of the seventh century. The years when the fence went up and came down remain open.
